# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 70 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 70

**1** Jesus said: "If you give birth to what is inside you, what you give birth to will save you. If you don't give birth to what is inside you, what you fail to give birth to will be the death of you."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Give birth to" — renders the bringing-forth as a generative, creative act; the inner potential as pregnancy
- "Be the death of you" — colloquial and vivid for the killing power of unfulfilled inner potential
- The birth metaphor connects to Saying 22 (making the inner as the outer) and Johannine rebirth language
